title: ficus notabilis
intro: Ficus notabilis, commonly known as the Indian laurel or Bengal laurel, is a plant species belonging to the family Moraceae. It is known for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving blood sugar levels, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Ficus notabilis include its antidiabetic, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory effects, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Ficus notabilis have been shown to possess strong antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and free radical scavenging activities, making it a potential candidate for the treatment of various diseases.
